columns.name: Id
columns.description: The unique ID of the case.

columns.name: Cid
columns.description: The unique customer account ID that the case belongs to.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: The user-defined case name.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: The user-provided description of the case.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The current status of the case (new, closed, in_progress, reopened).

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: The current user-provided severity rating of the case (1-100).

columns.name: SeverityInfo
columns.description: Additional information about the severity of the case.

columns.name: CreatedTimestamp
columns.description: The date and time the case was created.

columns.name: UpdatedTimestamp
columns.description: The date and time the case was last updated.

columns.name: StartTimestamp
columns.description: The date and time the case was started.

columns.name: EndTimestamp
columns.description: The date and time the case was ended.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: The current case version.

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: A list of user-defined labels applied to the case.

columns.name: AssignedTo
columns.description: Details about the user who is currently assigned to the case.

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.description: Details about the user who created the case.

columns.name: LastUpdatedBy
columns.description: Details about the user who last updated the case.

columns.name: Consistency
columns.description: Background processing details associated with updates made to the case.

columns.name: Evidence
columns.description: Evidence associated with the case (alerts, events).

columns.name: AnalysisResults
columns.description: The results of analyzing the case evidence (alerts, cloud_assets, events, files, hosts, users).

columns.name: ReferenceId
columns.description: Reference identifier for the case.

columns.name: CrowdStrikeDomain
columns.description: CrowdStrike host/domain configured for this connection; hard-coded on every record so hosts can be differentiated.
